title: 男士骨相野生眉设计：保留原生英气，不做生硬“画眉感”
title_en: Men’s hair-stroke brow design: working with bone structure without an over-drawn look
intro: 很多男生想改善断眉、缺眉尾、眉毛散乱或稀疏显没精神，但最怕做完变成“两条描出来的精致网红女眉”。男士野生眉的设计重心在顺应眉骨结构与原生粗硬毛流。
intro_en: Men considering hair-stroke brows for missing tails, gaps or scattered hair often worry about ending up with overly refined, drawn-on brows. Designing for men focuses on stronger brow ridges and coarser natural hair direction.

sections.title: 先明确门店规则：不单设独立档位，共用定制设计体系
sections.title_en: Studio policy clarity: no separate men’s tier or separate pricing structure
sections.description: 在描眉画目·定制美学，男士野生眉不作为单独划分出来的新增收费档位或独立项目单列，而是同样归入我们的仪器野生眉私人定制体系——由乐乐老师一对一结合你的五官骨骼、毛发条件选择合适工具与线条结构。具体当前门店项目定价均可在大众点评当期页面查看，到店前先讲清楚、不做升单。
sections.description_en: At Miaomeihuamu, men’s hair-stroke brows are not sold as a separate project tier or separate pricing category—they follow our core bespoke instrument brow system, tailored by Lele to each client’s bone structure and hair density with transparent pricing on Dianping and zero upselling.

sections.title: 男士眉与女士眉的核心差异：眉骨起伏、毛发粗硬与下缘留白
sections.title_en: Key differences in male design: brow-bone depth, coarse hair and clean lower edges
sections.description: 男士面部的额结节与眉弓骨通常更明显，原生毛发往往偏粗硬、长短不一或向斜上方/外侧杂乱散落。设计男士骨相野生眉时，最忌讳画出又细又弯的拱形边框或者拿重色把整条眉涂满：线条需要更干脆粗放一点，顺着原本粗硬毛发的生长趋势去补强眉头聚拢感和眉尾延伸收束，把散落杂乱的视觉重心收进眉骨线条里，同时在眉心和眉尾保留充分透肤感，看着像自己长出来的浓密好眉，而不是化过妆。
sections.description_en: Men typically have more pronounced brow ridges and thicker, less uniform hairs. Over-arched or solidly shaded outlines immediately look artificial on a male face. Instead, firmer structural strokes follow coarse natural growth to tighten scattered edges, extend sparse tails and preserve natural skin gaps so brows read authentic rather than cosmetic.

sections.title: 常见需要调整的三类男士基础：缺眉尾、局部断口与眉毛散淡
sections.title_en: Three common male briefs: short tails, local breaks and scattered lightness
sections.description: 从本店真实男士模特与顾客作品记录来看，常见诉求主要有三类：① 眉头偏浓但后半截明显变少、缺眉尾，正面显得眼角外侧发空；② 童年小磕碰或局部毛囊缺失留下的小块断眉；③ 整体眉毛颜色浅且往四周散长、不修边幅。每一种都不会搞成“一条线涂死”，而是通过局部补线与杂毛轮廓收束整理出清爽有神的眉眼比例。
sections.description_en: Common requests seen in our men’s portfolio include dense brow heads with faint or short tails, local notches from old scars, and pale hairs spreading loosely without definition. Each is resolved by reinforcing missing direction and framing clean edges without blocking out natural skin.

sections.title: 仪器操作没有尴尬期，可先到店免费试画再决定
sections.title_en: Instrument work avoids awkward flaking; preview free in studio first
sections.description: 对于平时要见客户或正常上班、几乎从不画眉的男生来说，画派仪器与双仪器方案最大的省心处就是没有尴尬期，操作当天即可正常洗脸（具体以当次所选方式及老师嘱咐为准），留色通常参考约2–3年，自然代谢后干净不积红蓝底色。到店设计免费约30–45分钟，乐乐老师先给你画出来看镜子对比满意再决定做不做，所有项目一样包含一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: For men who never wear brow makeup and return straight to work, our instrument brow approach avoids heavy flaking and allows same-day face washing, with a two-to-three-year working retention guide and clean fading without red or blue undertone buildup. Book a free 30–45 minute trial drawing first, backed by one-year free touch-ups.
